proposals.evidence: The kk expansion of laghu explicitly includes Palula lohōko small/young and Punjabi lauhkā small/young, as well as Domaaki lōka and Bshk lōk. These short/small survey lok- adjectives fit that regional light/small family. They are not assigned to the bare laghu node or the separate metathesized halkā series.
